positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
As a Senior Software Engineer, I lead the technical development of our Console product, enhancing developers' interaction with our NFT infrastructure. I collaborate with Product, Engineering, and Business teams to align software solutions with our business goals, within scope. My role involves mentoring junior engineers, ensuring high-quality software delivery, and developing intuitive user interfaces to improve the Console's usability.

I'm committed to setting high standards in coding practices, documentation, and software scalability. By integrating user feedback and market insights, I help tailor our product to meet user and customer needs closely. My work is supported by expertise in TypeScript, Next.js, MongoDB, and AWS, and involves close partnership with the Engineering team to implement and adjust software designs effectively.

positions.title: Senior Frontend Developer
positions.description: In my role as a Senior Frontend Developer at Likvido, I led the frontend development of their customer-facing accounting application. My responsibilities included designing and implementing highly responsive user interface components for web applications using Vue JS. I collaborated closely with backend developers to ensure seamless integration and functionality and with the Design team to provide an excellent UI/UX experience to the final user.

positions.title: Frontend Developer
positions.description: Most of my time at Sngular I worked helping to develop a back-office application for BBVA bank, aimed at measuring the implementation of a management framework across the company. My role involved working closely with a team of developers and project stakeholders to deliver a user-friendly, efficient, and scalable application tailored to the bank's specific needs.

positions.title: Frontend Developer
positions.description: Maintaining and developing new features for large Angular JS + Node + MongoDB app. Creating internal tools in React.

positions.title: Graphic Designer | Web Developer
positions.description: I've been mostly developing for myself and others, from static websites to complex web applications.
